format.structure: Each set has 5 tasks matching the official MET Speaking Test

part1.description: Task 1: picture description; Task 2: personal question; Task 3: preference question — all related to the same topic

part2.description: Task 4: advantages/disadvantages (unrelated topic, no opinion given); Task 5: roleplay/persuasion (school or community proposal)

tasks.prompt: Tell us about the last time you went shopping.
Some people like to shop at large chain stores that sell thousands of products. Others prefer smaller local specialty shops. Which do you prefer, and why?
A friend has won $20,000 in the lottery and plans to invest all the money. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this idea?
Your child's school is considering eliminating all physical education classes to focus more on academics. I am the school principal. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
Tell us about the last time you went to a park.
What do you prefer to do in a park: relax (reading, having a picnic) or exercise (running, playing sports)? Why?
Your city is considering building a new shopping mall in a large public park. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this idea?
Your neighborhood association is proposing to close the local park after 8 p.m. for safety reasons. I am a member of the city council. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
Tell us about a time you had to wait for someone at work or school.
Some people prefer to work in offices. Others prefer to work outdoors. What kind of work environment do you prefer? Give reasons.
A company is thinking about requiring all employees to return to the office full-time, including employees who have worked from home successfully. What are the advantages and disadvantages?

Your child's school is considering replacing experienced teachers with cheaper, less experienced teachers to save money. I am the school principal. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
Tell us about the last time you ate at a restaurant.
Some people prefer to eat at home, while others prefer to eat at restaurants. Which do you prefer, and why?
A friend is thinking about opening a small restaurant in your neighborhood. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this idea?

The city is considering banning fast-food restaurants within 500 meters of schools to improve children's health. I am a member of the city council. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
Tell us about the last time you traveled by plane.
Some people prefer to travel alone, while others prefer to travel with friends or family. Which do you prefer, and why?
A university is considering requiring all students to study abroad for one semester before graduating. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this idea?

Your local airport is proposing a new runway. It would increase the number of flights but create more noise for nearby residents. I am a member of the airport board. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
Tell us about a teacher you had who was particularly good or particularly bad.
Some students prefer to study in groups, while others prefer to study alone. Which do you prefer, and why?
A school is considering eliminating homework completely and assigning work only during class time. What are the advantages and disadvantages?
Your child's school is considering starting at 7:00 a.m. instead of 8:00 a.m. so students can finish earlier. I am the school principal. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
Tell us about the last time you exercised or played a sport.
Some people prefer to exercise at a gym. Others prefer to exercise at home or outdoors. Which do you prefer, and why?
A friend is considering joining an expensive gym with many facilities, even though there is a cheaper gym nearby. What are the advantages and disadvantages?
Your city is considering building a new public sports center, but this would require higher local taxes. I am a member of the city council. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
Tell us about the last time you went to a concert or live performance.
Some people prefer to listen to music alone with headphones, while others prefer live music or listening with friends. Which do you prefer, and why?
A school is considering cutting its music program to save money and focus more on math and science. What are the advantages and disadvantages?

Your neighborhood is proposing a rule that loud music and parties are not allowed after 9 p.m. on weekends. I am a member of the neighborhood association. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
Tell us about the last time you went to the beach or took a vacation.
Some people prefer active vacations, such as hiking or playing sports. Others prefer relaxing vacations, such as going to the beach. Which do you prefer, and why?
A friend is thinking about quitting their job to travel around the world for one year. What are the advantages and disadvantages?

Your city is considering allowing hotels to be built in a protected beach area to attract tourists. I am a member of the city planning committee. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
Tell us about the last time you studied in a library or another quiet place.
Some students prefer digital resources, such as e-books and websites. Others prefer printed books. Which do you prefer, and why?
A university is considering making all textbooks available only in digital format to reduce costs. What are the advantages and disadvantages?
Your local library is proposing to reduce its opening hours to save money. I am a member of the library board. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
Tell us about a time you or someone you know had to visit a doctor or hospital.
Some people prefer large hospitals, while others prefer smaller local clinics. Which do you prefer, and why?
A government is considering making healthcare free for all citizens, funded by taxes. What are the advantages and disadvantages?

Your city is considering closing a small local hospital to concentrate resources in a larger central hospital. I am a member of the health department. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
Tell us about the last time you visited a museum or historical site.
Some people prefer to learn history through books, while others prefer museums and historical sites. Which do you prefer, and why?
A city is considering making entry to all public museums free for residents. What are the advantages and disadvantages?
Your local museum is proposing to sell some of its less famous artworks to raise money for new exhibits. I am a member of the museum board. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
Tell us about the last time you used public transportation.
Some people prefer public transportation, while others prefer to drive their own cars. Which do you prefer, and why?
A city is considering making all public transportation free, funded by higher taxes. What are the advantages and disadvantages?
Your city is proposing to remove bus routes in low-traffic areas to save money. I am a member of the transportation committee. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
Tell us about the last time you spent a relaxing evening with your family.
Some families prefer to spend free time together at home, while others prefer to go out. Which do you prefer, and why?
A friend is considering moving back in with their parents after university to save money. What are the advantages and disadvantages?
Your neighborhood association is proposing that all residents attend a monthly community meeting. I am a member of the association. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
Tell us about the last time you watched a live sports event.
Some people prefer to watch sports on television, while others prefer to watch them live at a stadium. Which do you prefer, and why?
A school is considering spending a large amount of money on a new sports stadium instead of improving classrooms. What are the advantages and disadvantages?

Your city is proposing to ban advertising for betting companies during sports broadcasts to protect young people. I am a member of the city council. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
Tell us about the last time you met a friend at a café or restaurant.
Some people prefer to meet friends in cafés or restaurants, while others prefer to meet at home. Which do you prefer, and why?
A friend is thinking about opening a café that allows customers to work on laptops for many hours without buying much food or drink. What are the advantages and disadvantages?
Your city is considering banning cafés from placing tables on sidewalks because they block pedestrians. I am a member of the city council. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
Tell us about the last time technology helped you solve a problem.
Some people prefer communicating by messages and social media, while others prefer face-to-face conversations. Which do you prefer, and why?
A school is considering replacing all paper exams with computer-based exams. What are the advantages and disadvantages?
Your school is proposing to ban mobile phones during the entire school day. I am the school principal. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
Tell us about a pet you have had or would like to have.
Some people prefer dogs as pets, while others prefer cats. Which do you prefer, and why?
A friend is considering adopting a small monkey as a pet. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this idea?

Your city is considering banning the sale of dogs and cats in pet stores, allowing adoption only from shelters. I am a member of the city council. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
Tell us about a time when bad weather affected your plans.
Some people prefer hot weather, while others prefer cold weather. Which do you prefer, and why?
A city is considering spending a large amount of money on new systems to prevent flooding during heavy rain. What are the advantages and disadvantages?
Your city is considering banning cars from the downtown area on days with very high air pollution. I am a member of the city council. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
Tell us about the last time you helped someone or took part in a community activity.
Some people prefer to volunteer in their community, while others prefer to donate money to charities. Which do you prefer, and why?
A company is considering giving employees one paid day each month to volunteer in their community. What are the advantages and disadvantages?

Your neighborhood is proposing a rule that every household must pay a monthly fee to support local community projects. I am a member of the neighborhood association. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
Tell us about the last time you recycled something or tried to reduce waste.
Some people prefer to buy new products, while others prefer to repair or reuse old products. Which do you prefer, and why?
A city is considering charging residents for every bag of garbage they throw away. What are the advantages and disadvantages?
Your city is considering banning plastic bags in all stores. I am a member of the city council. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
Tell us about the last book, article, or story you read.
Some people prefer reading fiction, while others prefer reading nonfiction. Which do you prefer, and why?
A school is considering replacing its library with a digital learning center. What are the advantages and disadvantages?
Your school is considering requiring every student to read one complete book per month outside class. I am the school principal. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
Tell us about a time you applied for a job, course, or important opportunity.
Some people prefer a job with a high salary, while others prefer a job they find interesting. Which do you prefer, and why?
A young person is considering taking a gap year to work before starting university. What are the advantages and disadvantages?

Your local government is considering giving financial support to companies that hire young people with no work experience. I am a member of the city council. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
Tell us about a time you learned something online.
Some students prefer online classes, while others prefer face-to-face classes. Which do you prefer, and why?
A university is considering offering all degree programs completely online. What are the advantages and disadvantages?
Your school is considering requiring students to bring their own laptops or tablets to every class. I am the school principal. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
Tell us about the last time you moved house or helped someone move.
Some people prefer living in apartments, while others prefer living in houses. Which do you prefer, and why?
A city is considering building high-rise apartment buildings in a quiet residential area. What are the advantages and disadvantages?

Your neighborhood is considering limiting the number of short-term rental apartments to reduce noise and protect long-term residents. I am a member of the city council. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
Tell us about a science lesson, experiment, or discovery that interested you.
Some students prefer learning through practical experiments, while others prefer learning from textbooks and lectures. Which do you prefer, and why?
A school is considering spending more money on science laboratories and less money on arts programs. What are the advantages and disadvantages?

Your local government is considering building a new research center, but it would reduce the space available for public housing. I am a member of the planning committee. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
Tell us about the last movie or series you watched.
Some people prefer watching movies at home, while others prefer going to the cinema. Which do you prefer, and why?
A city is considering turning an old theater into a modern movie complex. What are the advantages and disadvantages?
Your school is considering using movies instead of textbooks in some history classes. I am the school principal. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
Tell us about a time you saw or experienced a dangerous traffic situation.
Some people prefer to walk or cycle for short trips, while others prefer to use a car. Which do you prefer, and why?
A city is considering installing more security cameras in public spaces. What are the advantages and disadvantages?
Your city is proposing to lower the speed limit on all residential streets to improve safety. I am a member of the city council. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
Tell us about the last time you used social media to communicate with someone.
Some people prefer to share their personal lives on social media, while others prefer to keep their lives private. Which do you prefer, and why?
A company is considering allowing employees to use social media freely during work hours. What are the advantages and disadvantages?
Your school is considering teaching a compulsory course about social media safety and digital responsibility. I am the school principal. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
